documented_facts: Eco IC is operated with MagIC Net Basic over a USB connection to a PC (official Eco IC manual).
MagIC Net documents export file types: *.idet, *.csv, *.slk, *.xml, *.cdf (AIA), *.txt measuring point list.
CSV field separator selection is ; | , | Tab; default ;. Record separator CR/LF | CR | LF; default CR/LF. Header on|off default on.
Filename options: Determination ID | Sample identification | Request on each export | Fixed file name (append data). Date stamp -YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.
XML export is documented as a section tree (Determination report / data groups / System data). Exact XML element tag names are not published.
*.xml and *.idet always export all fields; field selection applies only to *.csv and *.slk.

Partial-export behavior: Cancel skips one determination; Cancel all stops the marked set; existing Sample identification names get a version suffix; Fixed file name appends to an existing CSV/SLK file.
Encoding of export bytes is not stated in the public MagIC Net 4.0 export chapters.
unknowns: Exact XML element/attribute names and namespaces
Complete CSV/SLK available-field list and buyer template column order
Buyer MagIC Net version, license, export template, and City sample files
